column1: # Format: want<TAB>command, one per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
#   0      the guard must allow (exit 0): legitimate work that a fix must not break
#   limit  accepted limit: the guard cannot decide, so it allows. Each one is listed in
#          docs/threat-model.md with its backstop. If a fix starts blocking a limit row,
#          change it to 2 and update the threat model.
# A command that starts with json: is a JSON string (for newlines and other control characters).
# The runner (run.py) uses a project with no harness.config.json (default branch main) and a
# cwd that is a git repo on branch lane-x.
